License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1)
Upstream: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts
Compatible with MIT for bundling and redistribution in this repo (same faces
already ship under internal/pdf/assets/). Copied here so fixture-60/61/62 can
pin --font-path testdata/fonts/implemented-audit and prove embedding.
Family CSS names: "Liberation Sans", "Liberation Serif", "Liberation Mono"

Purpose: tiny glyph subset for fixture-64 CJK/fullwidth punctuation Effect demos.
